raw_response: {"translations":[{"id":"T0196","english":"Desklamp observation: first obtain the target object, then go to the furniture where the desklamp is located and use the numbered desklamp."},{"id":"T0197","english":"First confirm the locations of the target object and the desklamp; the desklamp is usually fixed on a furniture surface. If the target object and desklamp are observed on the same surface, first take the target object, then use the instance-numbered use desklamp <id>; do not first use desklamp when not holding the target object, otherwise it often returns Nothing happens. If the target object is not at the desklamp, first obtain it and carry it to the furniture holding the desklamp. After arriving, use use desklamp <id> to trigger observation; do not use a bare name or compound syntax, and do not treat the desklamp as a carryable object or navigation point."},{"id":"T0198","english":"If use desklamp returns Nothing happens, it usually means you are not currently at the desklamp's location, the current furniture observation does not include a desklamp, or the interaction conditions are not met; repeating the same use/examine/look command at the same location will not change the state and may form a loop or trigger protection. After one or two consecutive failures, stop repeating."},{"id":"T0199","english":"After failure, first check whether the current furniture observation actually lists desklamp; if not, move to another furniture where the desklamp has been observed instead of retrying the same use. If the desklamp is present, ensure the target object has been obtained or is held, then switch to the numbered use desklamp <id> to retry; if there is still no change, search other locations or declare that it cannot be completed, and do not repeat the same command."},{"id":"T0200","english":"When searching for the target object or desklamp, first check open surfaces related to the desklamp, such as desk, sidetable, nightstand, bed, dresser, sofa, coffeetable, etc.; once the desklamp is observed, go directly to the furniture where it is located and use the desklamp if needed, and do not continue traversing many drawers. If the target object is not on reasonable open surfaces, then systematically search by container type (drawer/cabinet), and return to the desklamp after finding it. Avoid repeatedly look/examine the same location; when there is no new information, move to other furniture or containers. 'under the desklamp' does not guarantee that the target object or desklamp is definitely at the assumed location, so when the assumed location is not visible, search other surfaces and containers."},{"id":"T0201","english":"When searching for the target object or desklamp, first check open surfaces related to the desklamp, such as desk, sidetable, nightstand, bed, coffeetable, etc.; once the desklamp is observed, go directly to the furniture where it is located and use the desklamp if needed, and do not continue traversing many drawers or unrelated containers. If the target object is not on reasonable open surfaces, then systematically search by container type (drawer/cabinet), and return to the desklamp after finding it. Avoid repeatedly look/examine the same location; when there is no new information, move to other furniture or containers. 'under the desklamp' does not guarantee that the target object or desklamp is definitely at the assumed location, so when the assumed location is not visible, search other surfaces and containers."},{"id":"T0202","english":"Desklamp observation: locate the target object and use the numbered desklamp at the furniture where the desklamp is located."},{"id":"T0203","english":"First confirm the locations of the target object and desklamp. The desklamp is usually fixed on a furniture surface; after observing the desklamp, go directly to the furniture where it is located, do not continue searching unrelated containers or blindly opening drawers, and do not treat the desklamp as a carryable object or navigation point. When the target object is not at the desklamp, first obtain it and carry it to that furniture; when the target object is already at the desklamp, first ensure the target object is in hand before interacting. After arriving, use the instance-numbered use desklamp <id> to trigger observation; do not use a bare name or compound syntax. Successfully turning on the desklamp is the termination condition; do not append use/look after it; if the target object has already been obtained at that furniture, do not go to the same location again."},{"id":"T0204","english":"Multiple failed trajectories show that take desklamp, go to desklamp, or repeatedly go to the desklamp/tabletop usually returns Nothing happens, wastes steps, and may block subsequent observation; the desklamp is an interaction point fixed on furniture, not a carryable object or navigable location."},{"id":"T0205","english":"Do not try to take, move, or navigate to the desklamp. First arrive at the furniture holding the desklamp (desk, sidetable, dresser, coffeetable, etc.); after arriving, directly use the numbered use desklamp <id>; if already at the desklamp, do not repeat go to the same location."},{"id":"T0206","english":"In failed trajectories, examine X with desklamp, examine the target object, examine desklamp, examine furniture (such as examine desk 1), bare-name use desklamp, use desklamp on X, and use X on desklamp often return There's nothing special about X or Nothing happens, and cannot replace the observation condition. Merely placing the target object on desk or desklamp without triggering the desklamp interaction also makes the task appear complete while the environment goal is not achieved. The valid interaction form is to use the observed numbered lamp instance, for example use desklamp 1."},{"id":"T0207","english":"After locating the target object and bringing it to the furniture where the desklamp is located, use the observed numbered lamp instance to execute use desklamp <id>. Do not use examine X with desklamp, examine the target object/desklamp/furniture, or compound use syntax; if invalid syntax has been attempted, check the desklamp instance name and retry instead of repeatedly examine."},{"id":"T0208","english":"If use desklamp returns Nothing happens, it usually means you are not currently at the desklamp's location, the current furniture observation does not include a desklamp, a bare name was used instead of a numbered instance, or the target object has not been obtained/the interaction conditions are not met; repeating the same use/examine/look command at the same location will not change the state and may form a loop or trigger protection. After one or two consecutive failures, stop repeating."},{"id":"T0209","english":"Using the desklamp requires being at the same location as the furniture where the desklamp is located; incorrect syntax (such as bare-name use desklamp), wrong location, or not holding the target object will not produce a state change; mistaking an empty observation for a retryable signal will repeat invalid actions."},{"id":"T0210","english":"After failure, first check whether the current furniture observation actually lists desklamp; if not, move to another furniture where the desklamp has been observed instead of retrying the same use.
